description: Guardas locais por etapa do Agent Flow

hooks.command: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');let d=process.cwd();for(;;){const s=p.join(d,'.codex','hooks','flow.mjs');if(f.existsSync(s)){const r=require('node:child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[s,'hook'],{cwd:d,stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status)}const n=p.dirname(d);if(n===d){console.error('Agent Flow: script do projeto ausente');process.exit(1)}d=n}"
